newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: NATO, Russia talks set for Tuesday - Primakov.
newsitem.headline: NATO, Russia talks set for Tuesday - Primakov.

text.p: Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov said on Wednesday he would meet NATO Secretary General Javier Solana in Moscow next Tuesday in a last-ditch attempt to clinch a NATO-Russia pact.
He said that only after that meeting would it be possible to say whether a deal could be signed at a special May 27 summit in Paris, clearing the way for the Alliance's planned eastwards expansion.
"I expect the arrival of Solana in Moscow on May 13," Primakov told reporters after meeting senior government ministers during an official visit to Luxembourg.
He said Solana would put whatever was negotiated in Moscow to the alliance's 16 members.
"Only then will it be possible to predict if the date of May 27 would be feasible for the signing of the 'charter'," he added.

During a long negotiating session on Tuesday in Luxmebourg, Solana and Primakov failed to reach a deal on a post-Cold War partnership -- seen as the centrepiece of a new European security order -- but said they had narrowed differences.
